nodes.label: AIBO Wave Logo Symbol (artboard-logo.png)
nodes.rationale: Compact logo symbol (1742x1742 PNG, 14KB) used as the mobile header brand mark at 40px (components/Header.tsx), while the wordmark aibow-logo.png renders in the desktop header at 360px (hidden md:block vs md:hidden). The symbol keeps the AIBO Wave mark legible and recognizable at small sizes where the full wordmark would not fit.

nodes.label: AIBO Wave Brand Identity
nodes.rationale: AIBO Wave positions itself as empowering the global creative citizen by connecting artists and entrepreneurs across Europe and Asia (README.md); the logo symbol is the primary visual expression of this brand.

nodes.label: Responsive Logo Strategy (symbol for mobile, wordmark for desktop)
nodes.rationale: Header.tsx swaps brand assets by breakpoint: aibow-logo.png (wordmark, 360px) is hidden below md, and artboard-logo.png (symbol, 40px) is shown only below md. This separates compact brand mark from full wordmark so the header stays balanced on small screens.

edges.source_location: visual content of PNG not readable by model; role inferred from Header.tsx usage
